meta.name: brief-generator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "create an influencer brief" or "write a campaign brief"; produces a structured creator brief with deliverables, key messages, creative direction, timeline, disclosure rules, and compensation terms. Not for choosing how to split spend across creators — use budget-optimizer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化的创作者简报，包含交付物、关键信息和时间线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为创作者或品牌合作撰写专业简报
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured creator briefs with deliverables, key messages, and timeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write professional briefs for creators or brand collaborations

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的活动信息，自动生成一份结构完整的创作者简报，包含交付物、关键信息、创意方向、时间表、披露规则和报酬条款。简报会保存到指定位置。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建一份创作者简报”或“写一份活动简报”，或者需要为某个活动向一位或多位创作者提供简报时触发。

say.text: 为我们的新有机蛋白粉创建一份Instagram和TikTok的微网红简报。
写一份TikTok产品评测简报，1条视频，包含披露和截止日期。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a structured creator brief with deliverables, key messages, creative direction, timeline, disclosure rules, and compensation terms based on campaign info you provide. The brief is saved to a specified location.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "create an influencer brief" or "write a campaign brief", or when you need to brief one or more creators for a campaign.

say_en.text: Create an Instagram and TikTok micro-influencer brief for our new organic protein powder.
Write a TikTok review brief for 1 video, with disclosure and timeline.
say_en.note: Claude generates a TikTok-specific brief with deliverables and timeline.
